model_name: Smooth non-phantom DE / wCDM local family

tested_scope.observation_control: corrected DESI DR1 ShapeFit AP+growth+shape local Fisher projection

scope_limitations: Covers the frozen C1 phenomenological constant-w local control, not all quintessence/k-essence realizations.
ShapeFit projection uses flat Omega_m=0.3, fixed present-day fluctuation normalization, zero local m+n derivative, and no nuisance marginalization.
This is not a full DESI likelihood constraint and not a precision replacement for CLASS/CAMB production predictions.
NONIDENTIFIABLE is data/observable-space blindness in this scope, not physical falsification.
design_prior_delta: DP-0101 controlled physical path to the reference limit
DP-0102 respect one-sided local geometry/tangent cones
DP-0103 optimize for observable whitened directions rather than raw theory distance
DP-0104 residuals must dominate and survive cross-solver calibration systematics
DP-0105 compare every clean local response to a real covariance scale
DP-0106 nuisance-free Fisher information is an optimistic ceiling; invisible signatures require orthogonal channels
